Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I found rongininterior.com through a Google search and noticed something that's actually a compliment — your SEO is strong. You're ranking for interior-related searches across dozens of locations in Bangladesh, from Dhaka to Chittagong to Sylhet. That takes real effort.

But here's the gap: all that traffic lands on a page that says 'Call now for free consultation' with one phone number (01677139529). Someone searching at midnight for a Rajshahi apartment renovation — they're not going to call. They'll bounce, and you'll never know they were there.

With residential, commercial, and hospitality clients across the whole country, you're already doing high-volume work. But every missed call from a location-qualified lead is revenue you're leaving on the table.

I built an AI enquiry agent that captures those visitors — it qualifies their project type, budget, and location in3 questions via WhatsApp or web chat, then books the consultation directly into your calendar. No missed calls, no cold leads, no manual scheduling.

I've built a working demo specifically for interior firms with multi-location coverage — happy to show you in 15 minutes. No commitment, just want you to see it.

Best,
Fahad
